title: Sclerotium / Clean-Root Recovery
objective: Build the smallest evidence-bound survival/recovery substrate so OTHRYS can identify what must survive, what can be rebuilt or reacquired, what must be rebound locally, and reject corrupt or wrong-body recovery material without smuggling secrets or authority.
laws: Minimal trusted pack contains only current-House identity/evidence required to reconstruct, never broad source hoarding.
Secrets are excluded; recovery records references/rebind requirements, never secret payloads.
Every item is classified REBUILD, REACQUIRE, REBIND, PRESERVE_EVIDENCE or EXCLUDE.
Corrupt, digest-mismatched or wrong-body material fails closed.
Recovery grants no execution, admission, approval or promotion authority.
Cross-node proof must show checkout/device portability of identity and recovery instructions.
